name: type:bug
description: Broken behavior, regression, crash, or reliability issue.

name: type:feature
description: Requested improvement or new capability.

name: type:docs
description: Documentation, examples, or project guidance.

name: type:question
description: Usage or clarification question.

name: type:security
description: Security-related tracking label; vulnerabilities stay private.

name: state:needs-triage
description: Needs maintainer review and initial categorization.

name: state:needs-info

name: state:accepted
description: Direction accepted for future work.

name: state:in-progress
description: An active implementation or investigation is underway.

name: state:blocked
description: Cannot proceed until an external dependency or decision changes.

name: area:web
description: React web client and browser-facing UI.

name: area:server
description: Server, orchestration, persistence, or RPC.

name: area:desktop
description: Electron shell or operating-system integration.

name: area:provider
description: Provider adapters, discovery, sessions, or capabilities.

name: area:docs
description: Documentation and website content.

name: area:ci
description: Build, CI, release, or repository automation.

name: good first issue
description: Scoped issue suitable for a new contributor.

name: help wanted
description: Maintainers welcome community help on this issue.

name: size:XS
description: 0-9 effective changed lines.

name: size:S
description: 10-29 effective changed lines.

name: size:M
description: 30-99 effective changed lines.

name: size:L
description: 100-499 effective changed lines.

name: size:XL
description: 500-999 effective changed lines.

name: size:XXL
description: 1,000 or more effective changed lines.

name: vouch:trusted
description: Contributor is trusted by the repository workflow.

description: Contributor has not been explicitly vouched.
